evidence_description: Defines active physical medicine interventions (therapeutic exercises 97110, neuromuscular re-ed 97112) requiring active patient participation and skilled therapist supervision.
Restricts passive modalities (hot/cold packs, ultrasound, electrical stimulation) to adjunctive role during initial 2-4 weeks; non-covered as standalone maintenance.
Mandates objective, quantifiable improvements in pain, range of motion, muscle strength, or standardized functional scales documented at least every two weeks.
Governs habilitative therapy for developmental delays, requiring standardized norm-referenced assessment scores (>1.5 SD below mean) establishing skilled need.
Establishes clinical criteria for rehabilitative and habilitative speech language pathology, swallowing dysfunction, and cognitive communication therapy.

evidence_description: Classifies unproven physical medicine interventions (dry needling, spinal decompression tables, chiropractic manipulation for non-musculoskeletal pediatric conditions) as investigational.
Sets professional documentation standards including signed evaluation, treatment dates, time-based code recording, and progress note retention.
Checklist capturing prior level of function, initial evaluation, measurable goals, treatment response, standardized testing, and discharge criteria.
Distinguishes restorative care from non-covered maintenance therapy; outlines episodic care criteria for acute functional flare-ups.
Standardized patient attestation form affirming termination of therapy at previous facility to prevent overlapping or duplicate authorizations across clinics.
